title: avena pratensis var. minor
intro: Avena pratensis var. minor, commonly known as lesser wild oat, is a variety of oat grass that is native to Europe and Western Asia. It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety, promoting sleep, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of lesser wild oat include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including avenanthramides, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Avena pratensis var. minor have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
